title: Looks Good, Very Soft, but not Great Quality
text:
Looks Good, Very Soft, but not Great Quality. I really liked this rug in the photo graphs, and I still like the colors and designs, but it does not exude quality in person. The pile is very short and you can see the white backing through it. It does feel luxurious under bare feet, especially when we laid it out over another carpet. It is very soft and we ended up putting it in front of our washer and dryer. It is a little thin and I'm not sure how it would wear in a high traffic area.

The backer is nice, it is all non-slide and it should stay in place very well. All in all, it's Okay, but I wish it was a little better made and a little thicker. But it is very reasonably priced and I think you get the value you should expect for the money.
